name: withme
description: WithMe app with local account auth and Spotify linking

scripts.dev:cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout certs/localhost-key.pem -out certs/localhost-cert.pem -days 365 -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1'
scripts.dev:cert:trusted: mkcert -install && mkdir -p certs && mkcert -key-file certs/localhost-key.pem -cert-file certs/localhost-cert.pem localhost 127.0.0.1 ::1
